image.digest_reason: Declaring a content digest requires NGC authentication, and the image was not pulled during P0.2; no digest was verified, so none is fabricated here.

multiarch.note: The Isaac Sim container now supports multi-arch. The same tag can be run on Linux x86_64 and aarch64 systems.

release_status.banner: Unsupported release: Isaac Sim 5.1.0 is no longer supported. Bug fixes and new features are delivered only in newer releases.

eula.license_name: NVIDIA Isaac Sim Additional Software and Materials License

privacy_consent.note: Shown in the official docker run example but optional; separate from the mandatory EULA acceptance.

eula.purpose_restriction: License covers install and use of the Software in systems with NVIDIA GPUs; selling, renting, sublicensing, transferring, distributing, or otherwise making the Software available to others is prohibited.

host_requirements.os_note: The Isaac Sim container is only supported on Linux.
host_requirements.driver_note: Tested Linux driver version listed across the Minimum/Good/Ideal tiers (Windows tested: 580.88).
host_requirements.gpu_unsupported_quote: GPUs without RT Cores (A100, H100) are not supported.
host_requirements.internet_note: Internet connection required for online assets and some extensions.

docker_run.rootless_quote: The Isaac Sim container now runs as a rootless user.

gui.quote: Running Isaac Sim with GUI in the container is generally not recommended.
gui.headless_note: The container supports running Python apps and standalone examples in headless mode only.

ros2.distro_note: Humble is recommended on Ubuntu 22.04 (and Windows 10/11 via WSL2); Jazzy is recommended on Ubuntu 24.04.
ros2.python_quote: Isaac Sim is compatible with Python 3.11 only.
ros2.dds_alternative_note: Cyclone DDS is supported on Linux only; it is not supported on Windows (WSL2).

env.ROS_DISTRO: Used to determine whether ROS 2 is sourced and which distro to use.
env.RMW_IMPLEMENTATION: Set before launch, e.g. rmw_fastrtps_cpp (default) or rmw_cyclonedds_cpp (alternative).
env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH: Append exts/isaacsim.ros2.bridge/<distro>/lib; can only be set once per terminal.
env.FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE: Multi-machine Fast DDS requires a fastdds.xml profile using UDP transport.

moveit_tutorial.package_note: Contains the launch files and parameters to run Isaac Sim with the MoveIt2 stack.

headless.run_flag_note: -v shows additional logs while the shader cache is being warmed up.
headless.readiness_marker: Isaac Sim Full Streaming App is loaded.
headless.plain_headless_readiness_reason: No readiness output is documented for a plain headless run without ./runheadless.sh.

gaps.detail: docker compose is not available on the host and compose.yaml defines no isaac-sim service; container orchestration for Isaac Sim is still missing.
The verified tag's digest is not_declared because NGC requires authentication and the image has not been pulled on this host; content pinning is impossible at this phase.
Docker 29.6.2 runs rootless with the nvidia runtime and CDI present, but a GPU-in-container run has not been validated because P0.2 forbids starting containers.
Wiring the mandatory ACCEPT_EULA=Y into a compose service is pending; no compose file currently passes the EULA flag.
No readiness marker is documented for a plain headless container run without ./runheadless.sh; how to detect readiness in that mode is unknown.
The container install page documents no --shm-size requirement; the shared memory needed by the container is unknown.
Default Fast DDS versus alternative Cyclone DDS has not been validated on this host/network; the RMW_IMPLEMENTATION choice is unknown.
Isaac Sim 5.1.0 is marked unsupported by its own docs banner while the repo pins isaacsim==5.1.0; the stay-on-5.1 versus upgrade decision is pending.
Reachability of online assets and extensions from this host is unverified; the requirements page states an internet connection is required for online assets.
